resources.string: KidGuard prevents curious little hands from leaving the app when active.
KidsGuard uses system protection to prevent accidental app uninstallation and manage wellbeing restrictions.
Protect your phone from curious little hands with a fake dead battery lock.

KidsGuard Screen is the ultimate family safety tool to protect your device from accidental use by children. 

Features: 
- Fake Dead Battery Screen: Stealthily locks your phone with a realistic dead battery animation.
- Multiple Unlock Methods: Secure PIN, secret tap patterns, or volume key combinations.
- Scheduled Lock: Automatically activate protection during specific times (e.g., bedtime).
- Child Safety Focus: Prevents app switching and accidental touches while active.
- Privacy First: No data collection, no ads, and no hidden permissions.
